metadata.title: Rota
metadata.description: Plan group trips together, in real time.

landing.headline: Plan the trip together, on one map.
landing.pitch: Rota is a group trip planner. Everyone adds places, orders the days and sees the same plan update live, even with a patchy connection.

landing.animationLabel: Two phones editing the same itinerary at once: a place added on one appears on the other.
